description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing orders in an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, and updating the status of orders, handling dependencies on repositories and security details.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller for handling order-related endpoints, including listing, retrieving, creating, and updating orders.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns a list of all orders for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order for the current user based on the items in their cart, updating stock levels accordingly.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing order; restricted to users with ADMIN role.
